_notes: Companies change ATS providers over time — verify each entry still resolves before you rely on it (visit the boards_url in a browser).
scraped: no public API — you supply CSS selectors for the ingestion worker to use. Lowest confidence, most likely to break, wrap in try/catch.
To add a company: add an entry below, then run `npm run seed`. No code changes needed.
Scraped entries whose company_name starts with EXAMPLE are ignored by the seeder — use that prefix for templates.

Kenya research pass (2026-08): most Kenyan fintechs/startups (Cellulant, Pesapal, M-KOPA, Wasoko, Twiga Foods) use their own ATS (Freshteam, Ashby, custom) or none at all, not Greenhouse/Lever — see config/outreach_contacts.json for those instead. Sendy (logistics) confirmed shut down in 2023, excluded. BrighterMonday Kenya and Fuzu are promising scraped-source candidates (many Kenyan employers post there) but their listing pages are worth checking with a real browser dev-tools inspection — a markdown-rendered fetch can't reliably yield literal CSS selectors, so no scraped entry was added for them here to avoid guessing selectors.

greenhouse.notes: Verified 2026-08 — 120 open roles at fetch time, several explicitly 'Nairobi, Kenya' or 'Remote, Kenya' (e.g. Financial Planning Analyst, Data Scientist (Fraud)). Fintech; board is EU-hosted for display but the standard boards-api.greenhouse.io endpoint works.

lever.notes: Verified 2026-08 — board resolves with real postings. Consumer lending fintech with a Nairobi office hub; postings at fetch time skewed toward MX/US/IN/PH, so Kenya-based roles may come and go — re-check before relying on it.
